_about: laneVIS2 item 8 (STAGED, not shipped). Read by the NEW Scripts/Zones/ZoneSky.cs (kit\code). A dark, slow HDRP CLOUD LAYER (baked lat-long texture composited in the sky pass; NOT Volumetric Clouds) in one global runtime Volume, priority 21. enabled=false, an absent file or -zonesky:off = nothing. Per zone only opacity / tint / scrollSpeed (km/h, HDRP Cloud Layer wind speed): they are render-time parameters, a zone blend never re-bakes the cloud texture. tint = fraction of a sky texel at the same exposure: the cloud exposure is read from the live HDRISky exposure (exposureFromHdri) + exposureOffsetEV; tintScale scales every tint at once (first thing to tune on the first frame). cloudMapPath '' = HDRP's own DefaultCloudMap. castShadows false = no cloud shadow cookie on the sun (extra cost, and the key must stay a clean low light). | V15 retune (apply_v15.py): tint solved per zone from the MEASURED sky (Yc = Ys*(1+frac/(op*coverage))), over-blend, lighting off, resolution 512, steps 4.
